messages:
Alex (Finance): FYI — Acme EU AP just rejected Invoice 2026-0543. They say the PDF doesn't show our full legal entity, PO# not prominent, and VAT needs to be broken out per line item. Can we prioritize?

Mari (Support): Thanks Alex. Can you attach the customer's PDF/email? Do they require 'reverse charge' wording or just the VAT split?

Alex (Finance): Attached the customer's screenshot and their email copy (they pasted the footer). Excerpt: 'Missing registered office, VAT ID only in footer, taxes not broken down per line item — our AP needs line-level VAT and supplier legal name for PO matching.' PO on their side is PO# 54321.

Tina (Legal): For EU B2B invoices we need supplier legal name, registered office (registered address), VAT ID (labelled VAT ID), and clear tax amounts per VAT rate per line item. If reverse-charge applies, include a note and show 0% with a reference phrase. Also confirm company registration number if available. Make sure PO number is visible in header.

FinanceBot: Current template variable dump: `{{company_name_short}}` => "Redwood" (printed in header), `{{company_legal_name}}` => "Redwood Inference, Inc." (present in data but not printed in header), `{{vat_id}}`, `{{registered_address}}`, `{{line_items}}` (each line has description, qty, unit_price, tax_rate, tax_amount).

Ole (Eng): I can update the PDF template. Proposed header fields to add: `{{company_legal_name}}`, `{{registered_address}}`, `VAT ID: {{vat_id}}`, `Reg. No: {{company_registration_no}}`, `PO: {{po_number}}`. For line items we should render `tax_rate` and `tax_amount` explicitly. Example Jinja snippet: ```jinja
{% for li in line_items %}
  {{ li.description }} | {{ li.quantity }} x {{ li.unit_price }} | VAT {{ li.tax_rate }}% | VAT {{ li.tax_amount }}
{% endfor %}
```
Will need the billing service to guarantee those fields are populated for exported PDFs.

Sam (Support): Repro steps for QA: 1) Create a test billing invoice with PO = 54321 and VAT ID = BE0123456789; add a line item with 21% VAT. 2) Billing UI -> Invoices -> Select invoice -> Export PDF. 3) Inspect header and line items for `company_legal_name`, full address, VAT ID, and per-line VAT breakdown. I'll run this now.

Tina (Legal): Also ensure the label says 'VAT ID' (some AP teams look for that exact string). If we ever do XML/UBL in future, include machine-readable fields. Not urgent but log it.

Ole (Eng): Aiming for a small template patch EOW. I need confirmation that `company_legal_name` and `company_registration_no` are safe to publish on customer invoices (no PII concerns).@Tina please confirm. :hammer: 

Tina (Legal): Confirmed — safe to publish. Use the registered office on file.

Sam (Support): Test run complete — current PDF uses `Redwood` in header, legal name is only in metadata/footer, and line-level VAT not shown. I'll attach the failed PDF export.

Alex (Finance): Thanks. If we can't ship EOW, send a short note to Acme AP explaining the change is in progress and advise they can accept invoice 2026-0543 if they match VAT ID BE0123456789 and PO 54321.

Ole (Eng): Understood. I'll open PR for the template change and ping QA.

Sam (Support): Will verify the PR builds and retest. :white_check_mark:

Alex (Finance): Appreciate it all — let's keep this as high priority for EU customers. :pray:
